notablePrerequisites: There is at least one other legendary creature on the battlefield.
description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Gogo triggers, causing it to become a copy of Ioreth until end of turn, and giving Gogo and Ioreth haste until end of turn.
Activate Gogo's second ability by tapping it, untapping Ioreth and another legendary creature.
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Gogo and another legendary creature.
Repeat from step 2.
